Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll extend Aston Martin contracts beyond 2026

Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll will remain with Aston Martin beyond the 2026 Formula 1 season after both drivers agreed long-term contract extensions, the team said on Tuesday. [1]

Things To Do This Week in Los Angeles [9-28-2026 to 10-2-2026]

The fall season is officially upon us. [2]

Stroll, who joined the Silverstone-based operation in 2019 when it raced as Racing Point, will enter his 11th Formula 1 season in 2027. [1]

The decision gives Aston Martin continuity as it seeks to improve its competitiveness, with Alonso and Stroll set to race together for a fifth consecutive season in 2027. [1]
